metadata.description: Grounded policy interpretation notes for validated SUMO simulation outputs, organized by scenario number and tau value.
metadata.important_notice: These notes are derived from validated simulation outputs and should not be interpreted as real-world crash predictions.

allowed_language: based on the tested simulation configurations

S1_tau_0.6.summary: Scenario 1 evaluated with a 0.6 s time-headway setting.
policy_interpretation: Based on the tested simulation configurations, this run should be interpreted as Scenario 1 under a 0.6 s headway assumption.
The 0.6 s setting represents the shortest tested headway and should be reviewed carefully for severe-conflict sensitivity.
Comparisons should be made against S1_tau_0.8 and S1_tau_1.0 rather than against unsimulated settings.
planning_relevance: Supports comparison of Scenario 1 across the three tested tau values.
Useful for evaluating whether shorter following-distance assumptions change the conflict profile.
limitations: Results are simulation-based and do not represent observed crash data.
Findings apply only to the tested network, demand assumptions, and behavioral configuration.

S1_tau_0.8.summary: Scenario 1 evaluated with a 0.8 s time-headway setting.
policy_interpretation: Based on the tested simulation configurations, this run should be interpreted as Scenario 1 under a 0.8 s headway assumption.
The 0.8 s setting provides an intermediate comparison point between 0.6 s and 1.0 s.
Comparisons should be made against S1_tau_0.6 and S1_tau_1.0 rather than against unsimulated settings.
planning_relevance: Supports comparison of Scenario 1 across the three tested tau values.
Useful for examining whether a moderate headway setting changes severe-conflict patterns.
limitations: Results are simulation-based and do not represent observed crash data.
Findings apply only to the tested network, demand assumptions, and behavioral configuration.
